title: $\alpha$-PFN: Fast Entropy Search via In-Context Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.07134v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Information-theoretic acquisition functions such as Entropy Search (ES) offer a principled exploration-exploitation framework for Bayesian optimization (BO). However, their practical implementation relies on complicated and slow approximations, i.e., a Monte Carlo estimation of the information gain. This complexity can introduce numerical errors and requires specialized, hand-crafted implementations. We propose a two-stage amortization strategy that learns to approximate entropy search-based acquisition functions using Prior-data Fitted Networks (PFNs) in a single forward pass. A first PFN is trained to be conditioned on information about the optima; second, the $\alpha$-PFN is trained to predict the expected information gain by training on information gains measured with the first PFN. The $\alpha$-PFN offers a flexible learned approximation, which replaces the complex heuristic approximations with a single forward pass per candidat

translated_title: α-PFN：通过上下文学习实现快速熵搜索
translated_abstract: 摘要：信息论采集函数，如熵搜索（ES），为贝叶斯优化（BO）提供了一个原则性的探索-利用框架。然而，它们的实际实现依赖于复杂且缓慢的近似方法，即信息增益的蒙特卡洛估计。这种复杂性可能引入数值误差，并需要专门的、手工定制的实现。我们提出了一种两阶段摊销策略，该策略使用先验数据拟合网络（PFNs）在单次前向传播中学习近似基于熵搜索的采集函数。第一个PFN被训练为以关于最优值的信息为条件；其次，α-PFN通过训练于使用第一个PFN测量的信息增益来预测期望信息增益。α-PFN提供了一种灵活的学习近似，用每个候选点的单次前向传播替代了复杂的启发式近似。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于两阶段摊销的α-PFN方法，利用先验数据拟合网络在单次前向传播中高效近似熵搜索采集函数，替代了复杂且缓慢的蒙特卡洛估计，显著提升了贝叶斯优化的计算效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces α-PFN, a two-stage amortized approach using Prior-data Fitted Networks to efficiently approximate entropy search acquisition functions in a single forward pass, replacing complex and slow Monte Carlo estimates for faster Bayesian optimization.
